answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the anchor check immediately, the island audit keeps the resolved set and the meadow replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 122 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 122 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
